title: When the Dealer Refuses to Cancel an Extended Warranty - Auto Fraud Lawyer Explains - Whitney, LLP
summary: A lawyer explains why dealerships stall extended-warranty cancellations and says customers have the legal right to cancel.

assertions.quote: I've not seen a bank that requires anybody to purchase a warranty or a vehicle service contract or prepaid maintenance

verdicts.note: These add-ons are optional products separate from loan underwriting; lenders don't condition approval on buying them.

assertions.quote: the car dealership will tell a customer that in order for financing to be approved, they are required to purchase the warranty
90 days is the usual industry standard
If a warranty gets canceled within 90 days, the commission gets taken out of the finance manager's pay plan

verdicts.note: Chargebacks on early cancellations are a standard part of dealership F&I compensation structures.

assertions.quote: the customer has legal rights and they can fight back

verdicts.note: Contract cancellation clauses are enforceable, and refusal to honor them is a recognized basis for consumer litigation.
